bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Outreach Program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE OUTREACH PROGRAM. +]

[+$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Outreach Program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.12. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Outreach Program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE OUTREACH PROGRAM.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Outreach Program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.12.
additions: APPROPRIATION; SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE OUTREACH PROGRAM.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Outreach Program under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.12.
